source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    full_rows = []
    for row in grid:
        if row[0] != 0 and all(v == row[0] for v in row):
            full_rows.append(row[0])
    if full_rows and all(all(v == 0 for v in row) or (row[0] != 0 and all(v == row[0] for v in row)) for row in grid):
        for r, row in enumerate(grid):
            if all(v == 0 for v in row):
                out[r] = [full_rows[-1]] * w
        return out

    cells = [(r, c, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v]
    # Pick the diagonal orientation on which the seed forms the fewest tracks.
    invariants = [lambda r, c: c-r, lambda r, c: c+r]
    counts = [len({fn(r, c) for r, c, v in cells}) for fn in invariants]
    fn = invariants[counts.index(min(counts))]
    tracks = {}
    for r, c, v in cells:
        tracks.setdefault(fn(r, c), v)
    period = len(tracks)
    residue_color = {d % period: color for d, color in tracks.items()}
    return [[residue_color[fn(r, c) % period] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
